author: FlowBhop and seven others
notes: Credit, and a start and finish read from the map's own spawn and end destination (gb-maps-2). A collaboration in eight mappers' stages, each with its own destination family: cp1..cp10, kotz_*, muha_*, sonia*, Linirtin_*, flow_2*, liana_*, amptele/ampfail. They are not stage lines here yet: which teleport is the door between two stages has to be read off the graph per stage. The finish is `finishend`, the destination of the teleport out of the last stage. Its boosters are trigger_multiples setting basevelocity (imported as pushes). Not published.
